messages:
Leah Nguyen: Quick heads-up — Lunara onboarding contract includes a single uptime commitment (99.95% monthly) + per-request p95 latency 350ms. Renewal flag expected in ~6 weeks. Can CS + Ops confirm we have reporting and credit calc ready? 3pm PT standup to sync?
Tom Rodriguez: I'll pull the last 3 months of uptime/latency numbers and a raw event export. Will share retention window.
Maya Chen: Need an enablement checklist for the customer success engineers — handoff steps, runbook, sample comms for credits. I can draft.
Ian Patel: Suggest we track p95 per API route + overall p99 for user-facing chat. Also want a rollback signal when latency > threshold for 10m.
Tom Rodriguez: @Ian noted. Quick note on calc: we prorate credits by minutes of violation relative to the monthly window. Example calc I'll paste in thread.
Tom Rodriguez: ```
# example credit calc
monthly_window_minutes = 30*24*60
violation_minutes = sum(incident_durations)
credit_pct = min(1.0, violation_minutes / monthly_window_minutes)
credit_amount = credit_pct * committed_monthly_fee
```
Maya Chen: Nice. Also capture evidence bundle requirements — logs, traces, and a signed incident timeline. Ops, can you standardize fields?
ops-bot: Evidence schema v2 uploaded to https://internal.redwood/ops/evidence-schema (permissions: customer-success,eng-sre).
Tom Rodriguez: Uploaded CSV export to GDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/abc123 — contains uptime calc, per-route p95, raw events.
Leah Nguyen: Great. Action items: Maya to produce enablement doc (due in 3 business days), Tom to finalize evidence pack and credit calc (2 business days), Ian to confirm per-route SLO list (EOD). I'll schedule 3pm PT sync and invite Renewal AE.
Maya Chen: Also flagging potential renewal risk — Lunara has elevated error budget burn last month (1.2x expected). Suggest proactive customer comms if trend continues.
Ian Patel: If we add an automated alert to the Renewal AE when projected credit > $X, that helps prioritization. Who owns threshold?
Leah Nguyen: I'll set threshold with RevOps. For now, threshold = $5k projected credit.
Tom Rodriguez: One more ops note — prefix caching reduced p95 on route /chat by ~40% after rollout on 2025-11-03. Include as mitigation in comms.
deploy-bot: deploy noted: prefix-cache v1.3 -> prod @ 2025-11-03T22:07:12Z :white_check_mark:
Leah Nguyen: Thanks team. I'll post meeting notes after 3pm and assign Jira tasks.
